m=re.search(r'(\b\S+) a [^;]*\brd?f?s?:label "Perimeter_mid_ZN_3" ;', txt)
# broader: find entity subject whose label is exactly Perimeter_mid_ZN_3
for mm in re.finditer(r'(\b[a-zA-Z_0-9]+:[a-zA-Z0-9_.]+) a ([^;]+);', txt):
    seg=(txt[mm.start():mm.start()+400])
    lab=re.search(r'label "([^"]*)"', seg)
    if lab and lab.group(1)=='Perimeter_mid_ZN_3':
        print(mm.group(1), '=>', mm.group(2).strip())
